notes.title: Future plans and a small bug fix
notes.notes:
I want to thank everyone for the warm welcome! I am very glad that many people liked the game and now I am even more motivated to work on the game further!

First of all, it is planned to:
- expand the existing levels of the game and remake the "ending" to a more interesting one
- Add new weapons and boss fight! 
- Add several new mini-games and events
- Add Achievements!
- Trade cards! (when steam allows them to be added)
and maybe something else...

After that, you can start adding new levels and content!

A small patch with fixes was also released: 
- Fixed a few minor bugs in the game
- Fixed a problem with the resolution in the game  (keep in mind that the game is designed for a 16:9 monitor ratio, so it may not be very convenient to play for square or long monitors, so you can switch to screen mode or I can add a setting with black stripes on the edges if it is more convenient)

If there is any problem due to the changes or you just found a bug, you can write here in the comments or in the Steam discussions, but I hope everything will work fine.

notes.title: Release date and Price of the game
notes.notes:
Well, there are no more reasons to postpone the game, so the game will definitely be released on the date specified on the game page: October 10 (at about 15:00 Moscow time). 

Of course, I would like to finish more content and implement all the ideas that I planned to add to the game, but this way you can postpone the release indefinitely, so it's better to finish everything that I wanted after the release of the game in the form of free updates. In addition, if the game goes well, then there will be enough ideas for a whole addition with even more content, mechanics and jokes! So I hope you enjoy the game :)

There are also a lot of questions about the price, so I will write here that the price will be 1.5 dollars at a discount on the release!

notes.title: Postponing the release of the game
notes.notes:
Unfortunately, we have to announce the postponement of the release date of our game. This decision was not made lightly, but a serious problem arose that could spoil the gaming experience or prevent the game from coming out at all!

On behalf of our entire team, we apologize for the delay to everyone who was waiting for the game on September 12, we ourselves were already ready to release the game and were very upset about the postponement. But it is important to solve this problem before the game is released, and now we are doing everything possible to solve this problem as quickly as possible!

We hope that you will understand this, yes, we made a mistake, but it's still better if the game comes out a little later than not at all... And she will definitely come out!
